evidence.excerpt: Alright, latest export attached. Sorry, I wanted to keep those generic "what's in the chart" or "how to read this chart" but only change the text around the specific data for this quarter.

What the chart shows: The sky-blue section at the base of each high-low bar is the average of the last broadly marketed asking cap rate for clinics that ultimately sold in the trailing 12 months; the dark-blue section at the top of each high-low bar is the average of the sold cap rate for those same broadly marketed sales in the trailing 12 months; the full bar shows the range of the spread between those two figures.

Deal-level bid-ask spread (how to read 2Q26): The line plots the average per-deal spread between each sale’s last ask and its achieved cap—not the difference between TTM averages. The long-run average spread in this dataset is ~44 bps; the most recent reading stands at 60 bps, narrowed from 75 bps at the end of the first quarter.
